exposure: Perinatal care model ("typical" - standard care model vs. "atypical" - Baby-Friendly hospital with collaborative practices)
cohort: 1,664 postpartum women and their offspring attending 13 private hospitals in the South-east region of Brazil in 2011/2012, divided into two groups based on the perinatal care model offered by the hospital.
finding: The "atypical" Baby-Friendly hospital with collaborative practices had a lower cesarean section rate and higher rates of beneficial neonatal care practices, without significant differences in neonatal adverse outcomes compared to the "typical" standard care model.
